verdict.rationale: Jeeves ships an official MCP server explicitly designed so AI assistants/agents can manage finances via natural-language requests ('ask about card spend, pay a vendor, pull a statement, submit a reimbursement'), directly matching the ai-native/agentic story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably in practice, and detail on the breadth of NL command coverage beyond the listed examples.
